info.description: Core banking API v1. Every data-plane call carries a tenant (X-Tenant-ID header in SaaS-dev/staging) and an OAuth2 bearer token. Financial writes require an Idempotency-Key header. Amounts are decimal strings in major units with the currency exponent (ADR-0004). Errors are RFC 9457 problem details.
